name: myTeamBenefitApplication
description: Applies for a benefit on behalf of one of the signed-in supervisor's direct subordinates. Call with employeeNumber/employeeName omitted to see the supervisor's team. Once an employee is identified, call with benefitType omitted to get that employee's own real, available benefit types. Once a type is resolved, call with fieldValues omitted to get that type's real field list. Always previews first, explicitly naming who the application is for, and only submits with confirmed:true. For the signed-in employee's own benefit application, use selfEmployeeBenefitApllication instead.
taskName: Apply for a Team Member's Benefit Application
